verdict.rationale: The evidence pack contains no mention of the M4 Pro's hardware media engine, ProRes acceleration, or hardware AV1/HEVC encode/decode support — it only covers GPU ray tracing, ML frameworks, memory bandwidth, and display specs. Since media engine capability is a plausible and expected axis for this chip type but is entirely unevidenced in this pack, this is 'none' rather than 'na'. Missing for 10: any documentation of hardware encode/decode for ProRes, HEVC, or AV1, and any creator-workflow benchmarks (e.g., Final Cut Pro export speed) referencing the media engine.
